description:
We are Lowkey — an ambitious, highly motivated, and hardworking team of innovators ready to make an impact. We thrive on complex challenges, continuous learning, and driving real change through technology.

By pairing our relentless work ethic with data science and software engineering, we are dedicated to transforming NASA’s Earth observation data into practical, sustainable solutions for global agriculture. We don't just solve problems; we push boundaries to build tools that matter.
summary:
TerraCycle is a web-based agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make informed crop rotation decisions using satellite and environmental data. The platform brings together NASA Earth observation data, soil information, climate indicators, and crop characteristics to help users better understand their fields and explore suitable farming strategies.

Users can select their location, analyze available soil and environmental conditions, review crop history, and explore possible crop rotation options. The platform also includes an AI assistant that helps explain information and answer agricultural questions.

TerraCycle addresses the challenge of declining soil health and changing climate conditions by making complex Earth observation data more accessible and practical for farmers. It aims to support soil fertility preservation, efficient water use, and more sustainable agricultural practices.

Our goal is to turn satellite data into practical knowledge that helps farmers make smarter decisions for the future of agriculture.
details:
TerraCycle is a web-based agricultural decision-support platform that helps farmers understand their land and make more informed crop rotation decisions. It combines satellite observations, environmental information, soil data, and crop characteristics to help users explore suitable agricultural strategies.

The platform works through several main sections. Users can select their country and region, identify their field on a map, and provide its area. They can then explore available soil and environmental indicators, review previous crops through the Crop History section, and use the Crop Rotation Advisor to explore possible crop rotation strategies. The AI Assistant provides additional explanations and answers agriculture-related questions.

Our project uses several scientific data sources: NASA POWER for climate information, NASA SMAP for satellite-based soil moisture estimates, SoilGrids for modelled soil properties, and Sentinel-2 satellite imagery from the European Space Agency (ESA/Copernicus). These sources help provide a broader understanding of agricultural conditions.

The main benefits of FieldShift are supporting soil fertility preservation, encouraging more efficient water use, and helping farmers adapt to changing climate conditions. Its intended impact is to make Earth observation data more accessible and turn complex environmental information into practical knowledge for everyday farming decisions.

We developed TerraCycle as a web platform using website development tools and AI-assisted features. Our team focused on creating a clear interface that brings different types of agricultural information together in one place.

What makes TerraCycle creative is its focus on connecting satellite data with practical crop rotation decisions rather than simply displaying environmental information. We considered soil conditions, climate, crop characteristics, water availability, and the needs of farmers when developing our concept.

Ultimately, TerraCycle aims to bridge the gap between space technology and agriculture, helping farmers make more informed decisions for healthier soil and more sustainable farming.
